title: Fit EGEP potential parameters
action: For each metal (Rh, Yb, Ir, Th) and each (n,m) parameter set listed in the paper's Table 2, determine the EGEP potential parameters (alpha_a0, alpha, beta, D, r0) by solving the stress-free equilibrium condition and matching the experimental bulk modulus using lattice sums over fcc crystal shells (include at least 248 atoms).
description: This step parameterizes the EGEP potential from the given experimental lattice constant and bulk modulus. It is required to obtain the potential parameters needed for the subsequent property calculations.
output_schema: Columns: metal, n, m, alpha_a0 (dimensionless), alpha (1e10 m^-1), beta (dimensionless), D (1e-20 J), r0 (1e-10 m). One row per (metal,n,m) combination.

title: Compute elastic constants, pressure derivatives, and cohesive energy
action: Using the EGEP potential parameters from the previous step, compute for each metal and (n,m) set: (1) second-order elastic constants C11, C12; (2) third-order elastic constants C111, C112, C123; (3) pressure derivatives dC11'/dp, dC12'/dp, dC44'/dp, dB'/dp, dC'/dp; (4) cohesive energy per atom. Write all computed values to results.csv.
description: This is the main scored artifact containing all target quantities. The checker compares these values to the hidden gold using tolerances.
output_schema: Columns: metal (str), n (float), m (float), C11 (float, 10^11 N/m^2), C12 (float, 10^11 N/m^2), C111 (float, 10^11 N/m^2), C112 (float, 10^11 N/m^2), C123 (float, 10^11 N/m^2), dC11dp (float, dimensionless), dC12dp (float), dC44dp (float), dBdp (float), dCdp (float), cohesive_energy (float, eV/atom). One row per (metal, n, m) combination from the paper's Table 2.
